rationale: HDB gapped up 3.7% on elevated relative volume but has since faded significantly from the session high of $27.81 to $27.30, now sitting at only 18.9% of today's range and below both VWAP ($27.52) and the 9-EMA ($27.38), indicating sellers have taken control after the gap. The last five 1-minute candles show tight, low-volume consolidation near the day's low with no directional momentum to support a clean entry in either direction. With SPY down 2.15% and VIXY up 6.10% signaling broad risk-off pressure, the risk/reward for a long is poor given the failed gap, while a short entry this close to the session low with only 18 cents of range above the low offers insufficient room before potential support.
